source.description: A DTD validated XML file that includes examples of ID and IDREF attributes and an entity that requires expansion.

test-case.name: system-properties-001
test-case.description: Check that the XPath version is at least 4.0

test-case.name: system-properties-002
test-case.description: Check that the XSD version is either 1.0 or 1.1

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-0021
test-case.description: Check that the XSD version is 1.0 when the implementation claims to support 1.0

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-0022
test-case.description: Check that the XSD version is 1.1 when the implementation claims to support 1.1

test-case.name: system-properties-003
test-case.description: Check that the product name is a non-empty string

modified.change: Reduced scope to be specific to product name only

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-product-version
test-case.description: Check that the product version is a non-empty string

test-case.name: system-properties-004
test-case.description: Evaluation of system-properties function.

test-case.name: system-properties-005
test-case.description: Evaluation of system-properties function.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-no-duplicate-keys
test-case.description: Check there are no duplicates in the key names
test-case.test: let $all := map:keys(fn:system-properties()) return count($all) eq count(distinct-values($all))

test-case.name: system-properties-006
test-case.description: Check that every key is a QName
test-case.test: every $key in map:keys(system-properties()) satisfies $key instance of xs:QName

test-case.name: system-properties-007
test-case.description: Check that the datatypes of the entries in the map match the signature in the spec.

test-case.name: system-properties-008
test-case.description: Evaluation of system-properties function.

test-case.name: system-properties-009
test-case.description: Check that the function is implemented sufficiently to return something

test-case.name: system-properties-010
test-case.description: Check that the function only returns the properties specified by the specification.

test-case.name: system-properties-011
test-case.description: Check that it has doesn't accept an argument

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-schema-aware
test-case.description: Check that schema-aware is set to true if the processor offers the ability to add schema components to the static context, using the schema import mechanism.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-schema-aware-false
test-case.description: Check that the schema-aware is set to false if the processor doesn't offer the ability to add schema components to the static context, using the schema import mechanism.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-accepts-typed-data
test-case.description: Check that accepts-typed-data is set to true if the processor is capable of handling nodes with a type annotation other than xs:untyped and xs:untypedAtomic.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-accepts-typed-data-false
test-case.description: Check that accepts-typed-data is set to false if the processor isn't capable of handling nodes with a type annotation other than xs:untyped and xs:untypedAtomic.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-xinclude
test-case.description: Check that supports-xinclude is set to true if the processor supports the xinclude:true() option in calls to fn:doc and fn:parse-xml.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-xinclude-false
test-case.description: Check that supports-xinclude is set to false if the processor doesn't support the xinclude:true() option in calls to fn:doc and fn:parse-xml.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-binary-library
test-case.description: Check that supports-binary-library is set to true if the processor includes implementations of the functions defined in the EXPath Binary Module 4.0

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-binary-library-false
test-case.description: Check that supports-binary-library is set to false if the processor doesn't include implementations of the functions defined in the EXPath Binary Module 4.0

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-file-library
test-case.description: Check that supports-file-library is set to true if the processor includes implementations of the functions defined in the EXPath File Module 4.0

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-file-library-false
test-case.description: Check that supports-file-library is set to false if the processor doesn't include implementations of the functions defined in the EXPath File Module 4.0

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-dynamic-xslt
test-case.description: Check that supports-dynamic-xslt is set to true if the processor supports use of the fn:transform function.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-dynamic-xslt-false
test-case.description: Check that supports-dynamic-xslt is set to false if the processor doesn't support use of the fn:transform function.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-dynamic-xquery
test-case.description: Check that supports-dynamic-xquery is set to true if the processor supports use of the fn:load-xquery-module function.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-dynamic-xquery-false
test-case.description: Check that supports-dynamic-xquery is set to false if the processor doesn't support use of the fn:load-xquery-module function.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-dtd-validation
test-case.description: Check that supports-dtd-validation is set to true if the processor fully supports use of the dtd-validation option for fn:doc and fn:parse-xml.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-dtd-validation-false
test-case.description: Check that supports-dtd-validation is not set to true if the processor doesn't fully support use of the dtd-validation option for fn:doc and fn:parse-xml.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-dtd-attribute-typing
test-case.description: Check that supports-dtd-attribute-typing is set to true if the processor recognises ID and IDREF attributes in a document that has been validated against a DTD using fn:doc and fn:parse-xml.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-dtd-attribute-typing-false
test-case.description: Check that supports-dtd-attribute-typing is not set to true if the processor doesn't recognise ID and IDREF attributes in a document that has been validated against a DTD using fn:doc or fn:parse-xml.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-invisible-xml
test-case.description: Check that supports-invisible-xml is set to true if the processor supports use of the fn:invisible-xml function.

test-case.name: fn-system-properties-supports-invisible-xml-false
test-case.description: Check that supports-invisible-xml is set to false if the processor doesn't support use of the fn:invisible-xml function.
